digest.component_or_area: Gerrit gate and GitHub mirror runbooks
propositions: Runbooks describe obsolete Verified enforcement and prior submit behavior that no longer match infra/gerrit/project.config
GitHub Actions is active and supplies Verified; GitHub Issues is disabled with planned future integration not yet available
LLM-Review label must reach MAX and carries across NO_CODE_CHANGE, MERGE_FIRST_PARENT_UPDATE, and TRIVIAL_REBASE; Verified carries only across NO_CODE_CHANGE and TRIVIAL_REBASE
Both label functions use NoBlock while submit requirements enforce both votes at MAX; LLM-Review also rejects unresolved comments
Submit action should document rebase if necessary behavior from project.config
Gerrit-only merging and rollback procedures must remain intact with no service setting changes
